evidence.title: PA日報 | More Marketsが攻撃され、約930万ドルの資金が移転；OpenAIが数万台のMacを調達しAIトレーニングを強化
evidence.body: [e002:f01] DeFi貸付規模が260億ドルに達し、6月比で約30%増加；暗号プロジェクト側は今年すでに約6.4億ドルを費やしてトークンを買い戻し、Hyperliquidとpump.funが約90%を占める；支付宝会長：暗号通貨が支払い媒体としてAI決済の探求経路の一つになっている；と関連するCronosがTectonicの攻撃により運営を一時停止、関与金額は約7500万ドル。 [e002:f02] 本日の重要ニュース： 暗号プロジェクト側、今年すでに約6.4億ドルをトークン買い戻しに支出、Hyperliquidとpump.funが約90％を占める Metaplanet、過去3時間でCoinbase Primeに2400BTCを入庫、価値は1.86億ドル イーサリアム現物ETF、先週の純流入額は8.24億ドル、ブラックロックETHAが5.67億ドルで首位 ビットコイン現物ETF、先週の純流入額は9.24億ドル、ブラックロックIBITが9.38億ドルで首位 Wintermute、過去2日間で約4億ドル相当のBTCをバイナンスへ送金 OpenAI、AI学習強化のため数万台のMacを調達、AppleのMac事業売上を29％押し上げ 関連のCronos、Tectonicへの攻撃で一時停止、被害額は約7500万ドル データ：HYPE、SUIなど来週に大口アンロック、HYPEは3600万ドル超を解放へ 規制・マクロ 中国人民銀行の陸磊副総裁、エージェント決済について語る：責任の境界は曖昧にしてはならない、自主規制条約を公表しプロトコルと標準を統括へ 中国人民銀行党委員会委員・副総裁の陸磊氏は第15回中国決済清算フォーラムで、エージェント決済は消費者、事業者、アルゴリズムシステム間の責任の境界を曖昧にしてはならないと述べた。 [e002:f03] 陸氏は、決済の本質は資金の権利移転であり、取引結果の予測可能性、責任の画定可能性、履歴の追跡可能性が客観的に求められるとの認識を示した。 [e002:f04] 大規模モデルや自律エージェントには出力のランダム性やロジックの不透明性といった特徴があり、エージェントに取引の意思決定権限を盲目的または過度に付与すれば、資金取引の信頼基盤に影響を及ぼすと指摘した。 [e002:f05] 「革新的技術の決済分野における安定的かつ秩序ある応用を推進するため、人民銀行は科学技術イノベーション、特にエージェント決済の追跡調査を継続的に強化し、決済清算協会が業界自主規制の強みを発揮するよう指導し、幅広い意見公募を経て『エージェント決済応用自主規制条約』を制定・公表した。 [e002:f06] 第三に、ルールと標準の先行を堅持し、異なるプロトコル・標準間の統括と互換性を強化し、規制当局に協力してエージェント決済の基盤プロトコルと技術標準体系の構築を推進し、ルールと標準における主導権を強化すること。 [e002:f07] 米・イラン情勢が再び緊迫化、国際原油は月曜にギャップアップで寄り付き WTI原油先物は上昇幅を2％に拡大し、1バレル＝85.137ドルとなった。 [e002:f08] ブレント原油先物は1バレル＝90ドルにタッチし、最新値は90.044ドル、日中2.21％上昇している。 [e002:f09] プロジェクト動向 Blockaid：More Marketsが攻撃を受け、約930万ドルの資金が流出 More Labs傘下のレンディングプロトコル「More Markets」がFlow EVM上で攻撃を受けた。 [e002:f10] OpenAI、AI学習強化のため数万台のMacを調達、AppleのMac事業売上を29％押し上げ 強化学習やComputer-use Agentなどのタスクを強化するため、OpenAIは数万台のMac miniとMac Studioを調達した。 [e002:f11] Appleの直近四半期のMac事業売上高は前年同期比29％増の104億ドルに達し、iPhoneを上回る成長率で、Appleのハードウェア事業で最も急成長している分野となった。 [e002:f12] 関連のCronos、Tectonicへの攻撃で一時停止、被害額は約7500万ドル CryptoCom関連のCronos Networkが、レンディングプロトコルTectonicへの攻撃を受けて稼働を停止した。 [e002:f13] この取引の具体的な条件や詳細はまだ明らかではないが、関係者によると、先週の予選終了後までこの契約は最終決定されなかったという。 [e002:f14] 重要データ Wintermuteの1.49億ドルのショートポジションが利益に転じる、ロングは約501万ドルのみ 暗号資産市場の下落に伴い、WintermuteがHyperliquidプラットフォーム上で保有する大規模なショートポジションが利益に転じた。 [e002:f15] DeFiレンディング規模が260億ドルに、6月比で約30%増加 オンチェーン信用需要の回復に伴い、DeFiレンディング規模は260億ドルに達した。 [e002:f16] 主要DeFiレンディングプロトコルの未返済ローン総額は6月の201億ドルから8月の261億ドルへ上昇し、夏の間に約30%増加した。

evidence.title: Anthropicがハードウェア接続標準「MHS」を発表、OpenAIとAIハードウェアの主導権争い
evidence.body: [e003:f01] モデルコンテキストプロトコル（MCP）の発表から21カ月、Anthropicは2件目の業界標準となる「モデルハードウェア標準（Model Hardware Standard、略称MHS）」を発表した。 [e003:f02] MCPに続く同社2件目の業界標準で、モデルとハードウェア間の接続プロトコル統一を目指す。 [e003:f03] MHSはデバイスに標準化ドライバー、自然言語による説明書、自己修復機能を提供し、研究機器の統合期間を数カ月から数時間に短縮する。 [e003:f04] 量子コンピューター企業QuEraの事例では、ClaudeエージェントがMHSを通じてレーザーロック復旧時間を150秒から6秒に短縮、成功率99.3%を達成した。 [e003:f05] 相反する2つのハードウェア路線 MHSの発表により、AnthropicとOpenAIのAIハードウェアにおける路線の違いが鮮明になった。 [e003:f06] 同時に、OpenAIはエージェント訓練用にMac miniを大量調達しており、AppleのMac事業売上高は前年同期比28.7%増、NvidiaのRTX SparkデスクトップAI機器も供給不足に直面している。 [e003:f07] 数カ月から数時間への統合革命 これまで、実験室や工場で複数のデバイスを相互通信させるには、プラットフォーム構築やハードウェア統合に数週間から数カ月を要することが多かった。 [e003:f08] 業界筋の情報によれば、OpenAIはモデルをハードウェアに組み込み、エッジ側モデルを中心に、自社でハードウェアを作り、自社モデルを使うという閉鎖型エコシステムの特徴を示しており、Appleの路線を再現する意図がうかがえる。 [e003:f09] アーキテクチャ上、Anthropicはモデルをハードウェアに埋め込むのではなく、エージェントがハードウェアに接続する方式を選択し、エコシステム上のポジションを上流のソフトウェア層とプロトコル層に置く。 [e003:f10] MHSの発表は、AIのハードウェア搭載というテーマがAnthropic社内で優先課題として浮上したことを意味するのかもしれない。 [e003:f11] AppleのMシリーズチップはユニファイドメモリアーキテクチャを採用し、最新のM5 Ultra搭載Mac Studioは最大512GBのユニファイドメモリを搭載可能で、メモリ帯域幅は1.2TB/sに達する。 [e003:f12] Appleの2026年度第3四半期のMac事業売上高は103.52億ドル（約1.7兆円）に達し、前年同期比約28.7%増と、同期間の他のハードウェアカテゴリーを上回る成長率を記録した。 [e003:f13] 新型M6 Mac miniの中国市場での販売開始価格は6,999人民元（約16.7万円）で、2024年のM4版の4,499人民元（約10.7万円）から約56%値上がりした。 [e003:f14] RTX SparkはGrace CPUとBlackwell GPUを統合し、最大1 PFLOPのAIコンピューティング性能と128GBのユニファイドメモリを提供する。 [e003:f15] 2025年、AIハードウェアブームはPlaudの出荷100万台突破を起爆剤に点火され、AIペンダント、AIリング、AIメガネ、AI玩具が爆発的に登場した。 [e003:f16] 今や、モデル企業側もハードウェアに「載る」ための準備を始めている。

evidence.title: AIによる大規模サイバー攻撃に備えよ--OpenAIら155組織が防衛強化を呼びかけ
evidence.body: [e004:f01] 「A call for collective action on cyber defense」（サイバー防衛に向けた集団行動の呼びかけ）と題する公開書簡には、155の企業や団体が署名した。 [e004:f02] 書簡は、「世界各地のモデルの能力が高まるにつれ、AIを利用したサイバー攻撃ははるかに広範かつ高度になる」と警告している。 [e004:f03] ただし、「長年積み重なってきた脆弱性を解消する方法はある」ともしている。 [e004:f04] AIモデルが、外部のインターネットには接続できないはずのOpenAIのテスト環境から抜け出した事例もある。 [e004:f05] AnthropicのAIモデルは、社名が明かされていない3社に侵入した。 [e004:f06] 「緊急性と連携」 OpenAIは公開書簡で、取り組むべき対策を大きく4つに分けて示した。 [e004:f07] まず、官民を問わずあらゆる組織は「最もリスクの高い脆弱性」を修正し、AI生成コードなどの安全基準を高めるとともに、権限設定とアクセス制御を強化すること。 [e004:f08] 3つ目は、国や地方の政府機関がサイバー防衛への資金投入を増やし、特に予算が著しく不足している部門を支援するとともに、「病院、水道事業者、地方自治体が高性能な防御用AIを利用できるようにする」こと。 [e004:f09] 書簡では、サイバー分野に対応できるAIをまず届けるべき対象として、重要サービスを守るチームを挙げた。 [e004:f10] 「最も危険な脆弱性を修正し、その修正を検証したうえで有効な方法を共有し、他の組織が活用できるようにすべきだ」 新たなサイバー防衛人材の育成を タルサ大学サイバー研究学部長のTyler Moore氏によると、AIが登場する前から、サイバーセキュリティーは脆弱な状態だった。 [e004:f11] 投資不足に加え、ベストプラクティスをめぐる合意がなく、セキュリティー保護策も十分に機能してこなかったためだという。 [e004:f12] 「組織が実際にセキュリティーを改善しやすくなるよう、AI企業にはリソースを提供してもらうべきだ。 [e004:f13] Moore氏は、AI企業がサイバーハイジーンのためのツールや手法を開発し、インフラ関連組織に無償で提供すべきだと述べた。 [e004:f14] また、さまざまな組織で働き、セキュリティーを強化できるサイバー防衛人材を育てるため、企業が奨学金を提供すべきだとも指摘した。 [e004:f15] 「残念ながら、社会全体のサイバーセキュリティーを改善する特効薬はない。 [e004:f16] 標的型スパイウェア攻撃の対処法 AIを使ったサイバー攻撃「黒船襲来より怖い」--孫正義が危機感 OpenAIと対抗サービス発表 性能の割に安いUSB充電器の動作が怪しいので分解したら「謎の塊」が入っていた話。

evidence.body: [e005:f01] 米国防総省はOpenAIのChatGPTとxAIのGrokを軍用に改修したバージョンを独自のセキュリティポータルに搭載し、軍人・文民職員を含む全300万人への提供を開始した。 [e005:f02] は開設当初、GoogleのGeminiのみを提供していたが、今回の追加で選択肢は3つに拡大。 [e005:f03] 登録者はすでに170万人を超えている。 [e005:f04] ChatGPT Milは行政・軍需・政策など文書中心の非戦闘業務を支援し、GrokはSpaceXのStarshield衛星網を基盤に作戦任務の遂行を支援する。 [e005:f05] AnthropicのClaudeは軍での使用範囲をめぐる意見の相違から今回のリストから外れた。 [e005:f06] 国防総省は昨年開設した統合セキュリティポータルに「ChatGPT Mil」と「Grok for Government」を追加したと発表した。 [e005:f07] このポータルは開設当初、GoogleのGeminiのみを提供していたが、今回2つのモデルが加わり、選択肢は3つに増えた。 [e005:f08] 国防総省によると、には全人員300万人のうち170万人以上がすでに登録している。 [e005:f09] 2つのモデルの用途は明確に区別されている。 [e005:f10] 国防総省は報道資料で「Starshield AIのGrok for Governmentは、戦闘員に即時の生産性向上、より強力な知識の継続性、より安全で効率的な協業を提供する」と述べた。 [e005:f11] 今回の発表で目立つ空白は、AnthropicのClaudeだ。 [e005:f12] Anthropicは自社技術が完全自律型兵器や自国民を対象とした大規模監視に使用されないようにする安全装置を要求したが、国防総省は合法的な目的全般において制約なく使用できるべきだという立場を崩さず、意見の相違を埋められなかった。 [e005:f13] これにより、防衛関連の契約業者もAnthropicの技術を使用できなくなった。 [e005:f14] Anthropicはこの決定に不服として訴訟を提起し、8月末にカリフォルニア連邦地方裁判所は当該指定が違法だと判断した。 [e005:f15] 国防総省は今回のモデル追加とは別に、AI能力の強化のためAmazon Web Services（AWS）、Microsoft、NVIDIA、Reflection AIなど複数の企業とも協力してきた。 [e005:f16] 国防総省はセキュリティを維持しながらAIで業務の速度と能力を高めるという戦略を明確にしており、テクノロジー企業との協力範囲を今後も拡大していくとみられる。

OpenAI blames Apple security practices in trade secrets lawsuit
evidence.body: [e001:f01] OpenAI blamed Apple's own security practices for its trade secrets mess OpenAI filed a court brief calling the dispute "a mess of Apple's own making," citing the company's data policies and offboarding procedures By Cris Tolomia · 3 min read · Updated September 1, 2026 Add QZ to Google Samuel Boivin/NurPhoto via Getty Images OpenAI denied Apple $AAPL 's allegations of trade secret theft on Monday, arguing that the iPhone maker's own security policies and offboarding procedures were responsible for any improper access to its internal files, according to Reuters. [e001:f02] "This dispute is a mess of Apple 's own making, and it is trying to blame everyone else," OpenAI said in a filing in U.S. [e001:f03] District Court in San Jose, California. [e001:f04] The company added that Apple "cannot use its own sloppy procedures to blame others for its own mess." OpenAI's filing pointed to two specific Apple practices it said created the conditions for the dispute. [e001:f05] The company said Apple encourages employees to use personal iCloud accounts to access work documents, making it difficult for departing workers to separate personal and company files. [e001:f06] OpenAI also took issue with Apple 's practice of walking departing workers out immediately, arguing that it leaves employees no meaningful window to return equipment, move internal data back to the company, or transition their duties. [e001:f07] The filing also addressed the conduct of the two former Apple employees named in the lawsuit. [e001:f08] Tang Tan, a 24-year Apple veteran who now leads hardware at OpenAI, stated in the filing that he gave back all Apple prototypes prior to his exit and kept nothing that qualified as confidential, pointing to an employee departure checklist as an example of what he held onto. [e001:f09] OpenAI further contended that the lawsuit is an attempt by Apple to hamper a rival and make employees think twice before leaving, invoking California's longstanding protections for workers who choose to join competing firms. [e001:f10] As detailed in earlier coverage , Apple alleged that Chang Liu had incorporated a proprietary Apple circuit schematic into his work at OpenAI and that he directed a colleague to destroy evidence after learning he was under investigation. [e001:f11] Apple 's brief centered on a forensic analysis of an Apple -issued MacBook that OpenAI provided only after weeks of delay, according to Apple . [e001:f12] Apple has maintained that Chang Liu's post-departure access to its files resulted from his exploitation of an authentication vulnerability, while OpenAI has countered that Apple 's own inadequate procedures for revoking system access were to blame. [e001:f13] Apple sued OpenAI in July, accusing it, io Products — its hardware-focused subsidiary — and the two former employees of misappropriating trade secrets related to hardware design, manufacturing, and supply-chain operations. [e001:f14] More than 400 former Apple employees now work at OpenAI, according to court filings. [e001:f15] The legal clash underscored how sharply relations between the two companies have soured since their earlier collaboration to bring ChatGPT into Siri — an arrangement that ultimately fell apart after Apple announced plans to rebuild Siri around Google $GOOGL Gemini. evidence.title: ソフトバンクG出資のSBエナジー、米国でIPO申請－AI向け電力需要狙う（Bloomberg）
evidence.body: [e004:f01] ソフトバンクG出資のSBエナジー、米国でIPO申請－AI向け電力需要狙う 9/1(火) 20:08 配信 ソフトバンクグループの孫正義社長 （ブルームバーグ）： ソフトバンクグループとOpenAIが出資する電力インフラ企業SBエナジーが、米国での新規株式公開（IPO）を申請した。 [e004:f02] データセンター向けの電力需要拡大を踏まえ、成長加速への体制を整える。 [e004:f03] SBエナジーが1日、米証券取引委員会（SEC）に提出した文書によると、今年1－6月（上期）の同社の売上高は1億3900万ドル（約222億円）、純損失が32億ドル。 [e004:f04] 前年同期は売上高が8300万ドル、純損失2億1600万ドルだった。 [e004:f05] カリフォルニア州レッドウッドシティに本社を置くSBエナジーは、太陽光発電および蓄電池資産のポートフォリオを保有し、オハイオ州で9.2ギガワットの天然ガス発電所の開発を進めている。 [e004:f06] 同社がデジタルインフラへの注力を強める中で、このガス発電所はAIデータセンターへの電力供給を担うことになる。 [e004:f07] ソフトバンクGとOpenAIは今年に入り、SBエナジーに5億ドルずつ投資することで合意。 [e004:f08] SBエナジーは、OpenAI向けデータセンターをテキサス州で建設・運営する資金に充てる。 [e004:f09] 米投資運用会社アレス・マネジメントもSBエナジーに投資している。 [e004:f10] ブルームバーグ・インテリジェンスのアナリスト、カーク・ブードリー氏は5月のリポートで、SBエナジーがIPOを実施するなら、ソフトバンクGの資産評価やAI投資計画を賄う資金調達能力への懸念が和らぐはずだと指摘。 [e004:f11] 「大規模なデータセンター投資の資金調達を関連会社に移すことで、ソフトバンクは親会社レベルでの流動性圧力を軽減できる」と同氏は論じた。 [e004:f12] テクノロジー各社はAIデータセンターの拡充に向けて電力やインフラへの支出を増やしている。 [e004:f13] UBSグループのアナリストらは、データセンターを中心に必要となる電力の不足を補うための投資額は2030年までに5110億ドルに上ると見込んでいる。 [e004:f14] SBエナジーのIPO主幹事はJPモルガン・チェース、ゴールドマン・サックス・グループ、モルガン・スタンレー、シティグループ、みずほが務める。 [e004:f15] 前へ 1 2 次へ 1 / 2ページ 【関連記事】 ホルムズ海峡で大型原油タンカー2隻が攻撃受ける、原油は上げ拡大 米IPOへの道､今秋は｢狭き門｣に－アンソロピック大型上場を他社は警戒 米国が覚書履行ならイランも相応措置－ペゼシュキアン大統領表明 エアビー、宿泊施設提供者の手数料引き下げを試験－直接予約に対抗 米30年債、2006年以来の低迷続く中での9月入り－投資家は警戒維持へ。

evidence.title: Japanese automakers Nissan and Honda agree to work together on software for cars
evidence.body: [e005:f01] All rights reserved. ) Japanese automakers Nissan and Honda entered a deal to jointly develop computer parts and software for vehicles set to enter the market in fiscal 2029, both sides said Monday. [e005:f02] Nissan and Honda started talks in 2024 to work together in developing electric vehicles and auto intelligence technology. [e005:f03] Nissan makes Leaf electric cars and Infiniti luxury models, while Honda makes the Accord sedan, Civic compact and Odyssey minivan. [e005:f04] Monday’s agreement did not specifically mention EVs, or any model names, and was focused on so-called software-defined vehicles, which could include EVs. [e005:f05] These vehicles have functions and features that can be updated and controlled by software, rather than the mechanics of hardware. [e005:f06] The global competition in the auto industry is increasingly intensifying as it moves into various technologies, such as automated driving and zero emissions. [e005:f07] Each vehicle is starting to be more like a computer packed with electronic parts and software rather than the old image of the gas-guzzling engines. [e005:f08] Sharing components and collaborating on research will help cut costs and speed up development, as well as add efficiency in economy of scale once the vehicles go into production. [e005:f09] Both Nissan and Honda are overshadowed by Toyota Motor Corp., the top Japanese automaker, and working together could be a plus in competing against Toyota. [e005:f10] However, Toyota has been mentioned in the past as engaging in the software talks with Nissan and Honda, although it was not part of Monday’s announcement. [e005:f11] Toyota is working on software with other companies like Subaru, which is part of the Toyota group, and U.S. autonomous driving technology company Waymo. [e005:f12] As part of their strategic partnership, Nissan and Honda will continue to explore other opportunities for collaboration across a range of areas, including zero-emissions and decreasing traffic fatalities. [e005:f13] Both sides stressed that the use of intelligence and electrification technology is an important focus for working together. [e005:f14] “Recognizing the need to strengthen competitiveness through faster development cycles and more efficient investment, the two companies have conducted extensive studies on potential collaboration in the software domain,” they said in a statement. ___ Yuri Kageyama is on Threads: https://。

evidence.title: Honda and Nissan announce development partnership
evidence.body: [e004:f01] News Industry Honda, Nissan to tie up after all After knocking back a proposed merger last year, Honda and Nissan have agreed to develop standardised electronic components for some future vehicles. by Jordan Mulach Published September 01, 2026 In 2025, Honda and Nissan walked away from a proposed merger between their two brands and Mitsubishi, at the time navigating financial difficulties and a changing market. [e004:f02] With a new CEO at the helm of Nissan and Honda fighting back from its first ever financial loss, the two Japanese marques have now agreed to form a relationship, though not to the in-depth levels as once proposed. [e004:f03] Overnight, Honda and Nissan announced they have “entered into a joint development agreement to standardise multiple electronic control units (ECUs) that form the core of next-generation software-defined vehicles (SDVs)”. [e004:f04] In addition, the brands will develop “the in-vehicle operating system and key parts of the middleware, and vehicle control software that run on these ECUs.” Honda Civic Type R “As part of their strategic partnership, Nissan and Honda continue to explore opportunities for collaboration across a range of areas to accelerate progress toward carbon neutrality and help realize a future with zero traffic fatalities involving their vehicles,” the pair said in a joint media release. ‘In particular, the software domain centered on SDVs, which is key to vehicle intelligence and electrification, has been identified as an important area of collaboration, given the rapid pace of technological innovation and the need to strengthen competitiveness through improved R&D speed and investment efficiency.” They noted the need to be more competitive in the current market, flagging faster development cycles as a key to remain in the fight against rapid technological advances from competitors. [e004:f05] “Going forward, Nissan and Honda will continue to build on their respective strengths, explore opportunities to create new value, and deepen collaboration to bring tangible benefits to customers and society.” Nissan Patrol The co-developed technology won’t start rolling out until the 2029 Japanese fiscal year (April 2029 to April 2030), while the door has been left open for future projects. [e004:f06] Earlier this year, Honda announced in May it had posted an operating loss of 414.3 billion yen (A$3.72 billion) for the 2025-2026 Japanese financial year (April 2025 to March 2026), a significant change on its previous operating profit of 1.21 trillion yen (A$10.9 billion). [e004:f07] “I would like to ​express my deepest apologies to our shareholders for the significant concern and inconvenience caused ​by the net loss recorded in the previous fiscal year's financial results,” Honda CEO Toshihiro Mibe said in announcing the results. [e004:f08] Nissan CEO Ivan Espinosa has also previously said his brand “lost our” way prior to taking over, having inherited the control of a company which posted an annual net loss of ¥670.9 billion (A$6.2 billion). by Jordan Mulach Published September 01, 2026。

evidence.title: Nissan, Honda Sign Software Deal 18 Months After Merger Collapsed
evidence.body: [e001:f01] The automakers will standardize several of the ECUs at the centre of next-generation software-defined vehicles, along with the in-vehicle operating system, key parts of the middleware and vehicle control software running on them to reduce development costs and gain economies of scale. [e001:f02] The electrical and electronic architecture built around those components is planned for use in both companies’ next-generation vehicles from fiscal 2029 onward — a Japanese fiscal year beginning in April 2029. [e001:f03] What the Agreement Does Not Cover The announcement is confined to shared componentry and software layers. [e001:f04] It does not describe joint vehicles, shared platforms, a new corporate entity, capital ties or any equity arrangement, and it names no models, investment figure or development split. [e001:f05] Both companies describe the deal as part of an existing strategic partnership under which they “continue to explore opportunities for collaboration” — language that frames this as one concrete outcome inside a broader, still-provisional relationship rather than a comprehensive tie-up. [e001:f06] In a statement on Monday, Nissan’s alliance partner said it was considering joining the collaboration and remained in discussions with both companies on potential areas of cooperation. [e001:f07] The Context, Stated Precisely Nissan and Honda announced on December 23, 2024 that they had signed a memorandum of understanding to explore integrating their businesses under a joint holding company, with a listing planned for August 2026 — a month that has now passed with no such company in existence. [e001:f08] The three companies said then that they would continue a strategic partnership covering batteries, autonomous driving, software and electric vehicle technology. [e001:f09] It is not a resumption of merger talks, and nothing in the announcement suggests one. [e001:f10] Nissan was widely read as the weaker party in 2024; Honda spent the first half of 2026 cancelling electric vehicle programmes of its own. [e001:f11] How It Was Signalled Honda President Toshihiro Mibe told the company’s annual shareholders’ meeting in June that conversations with Nissan were “quite far along,” with some elements close to announcement. [e001:f12] Nissan chief executive Ivan Espinosa said in July that news was likely in three areas: US manufacturing capacity, hardware for electric vehicle architectures — with an open question over “whether we should have a common software stack, up to what level” — and battery supply for hybrids in the US. [e001:f13] Today’s agreement answers the second of those three, partially. [e001:f14] Nikkei reported the deal on Saturday, ahead of the announcement. [e001:f15] Honda told Reuters at the time that no deal had been decided; a Nissan spokesperson said the company was exploring various possibilities. [e001:f16] Cláudio Afonso 31st August 2026 Cláudio Afonso View More Posts Cláudio Afonso founded CARBA in early 2021 and launched the news blog EV later that year.

evidence.title: Japanese automakers Nissan and Honda agree to work together on software for cars
evidence.body: [e003:f01] 6, 2025. (AP Photo/Michael Conroy, File) TOKYO (AP) — Japanese automakers Nissan and Honda entered a deal to jointly develop computer parts and software for vehicles set to enter the market in fiscal 2029, both sides said Monday. [e003:f02] Nissan and Honda started talks in 2024 to work together in developing electric vehicles and auto intelligence technology. [e003:f03] Nissan makes Leaf electric cars and Infiniti luxury models, while Honda makes the Accord sedan, Civic compact and Odyssey minivan. [e003:f04] Monday’s agreement did not specifically mention EVs, or any model names, and was focused on so-called software-defined vehicles, which could include EVs. [e003:f05] These vehicles have functions and features that can be updated and controlled by software, rather than the mechanics of hardware. [e003:f06] The global competition in the auto industry is increasingly intensifying as it moves into various technologies, such as automated driving and zero emissions. [e003:f07] Each vehicle is starting to be more like a computer packed with electronic parts and software rather than the old image of the gas-guzzling engines. [e003:f08] Sharing components and collaborating on research will help cut costs and speed up development, as well as add efficiency in economy of scale once the vehicles go into production. [e003:f09] Both Nissan and Honda are overshadowed by Toyota Motor Corp., the top Japanese automaker, and working together could be a plus in competing against Toyota. [e003:f10] However, Toyota has been mentioned in the past as engaging in the software talks with Nissan and Honda, although it was not part of Monday’s announcement. [e003:f11] Toyota is working on software with other companies like Subaru, which is part of the Toyota group, and U.S. autonomous driving technology company Waymo. [e003:f12] As part of their strategic partnership, Nissan and Honda will continue to explore other opportunities for collaboration across a range of areas, including zero-emissions and decreasing traffic fatalities. [e003:f13] Both sides stressed that the use of intelligence and electrification technology is an important focus for working together. [e003:f14] “Recognizing the need to strengthen competitiveness through faster development cycles and more efficient investment, the two companies have conducted extensive studies on potential collaboration in the software domain,” they said in a statement. ___ Yuri Kageyama is on Threads: https:// By YURI KAGEYAMA AP Business Writer Related Post Schumer: Americans Pay, Trump Profits Senate Minority Democratic Leader Chuck Schumer (D-NY) spoke on the Senate floor vowing to expose… Emergency Sewer Work To Slow Traffic In Sonora TUD advises the repairs will take place on South Washington Street, and there will be… Forest Releases Final SERAL Projects Environmental Impact Statement Stanislaus National Forest Supervisor shares that not everyone got everything they were looking for. evidence.title: Red Bull announces Aston Martin director as Lambiase replacement from F1 2027
evidence.body: [e002:f01] Red Bull has chosen Tom McCullough, currently Aston Martin’s performance director, to become its race operations chief in Formula 1 from the 2027 season News summary Red Bull has appointed Tom McCullough as its new head of race operations from the 2027 F1 season . [e002:f02] The Briton currently works as Aston Martin’s performance director and will take over duties currently handled by Gianpiero Lambiase. [e002:f03] McCullough is part of a broader Red Bull restructuring ahead of the major technical changes coming to Formula 1 in 2027 . [e002:f04] The Briton, who currently serves as Aston Martin’s performance director, had already been tipped as Gianpiero Lambiase’s successor at Milton Keynes after the engineer signed with McLaren for 2028. [e002:f05] McCullough joined Force India at the beginning of 2014 and is one of the remaining members from the period surrounding the team’s sale to the consortium led by Lawrence Stroll in 2018. [e002:f06] Now, however, McCullough is preparing to move to Red Bull for the 2027 season , while Jonathan Wheatley, the former Audi team principal, is preparing to replace him at Fernando Alonso and Lance Stroll’s team. [e002:f07] GRANDE PRÊMIO previously reported on Wheatley’s expected departure from Aston Martin at the end of the 2026 season. [e002:f08] The Briton also becomes one of the faces of Red Bull’s restructuring process in F1, which recently included the arrival of Gwen Lagrue, formerly of Mercedes, as director of the driver academy. [e002:f09] “We are delighted to welcome Tom to the team at the start of 2027 and look forward to benefiting from all the experience and knowledge he will bring to the role,” Red Bull said in a brief statement. [e002:f10] Gianpiero Lambiase has signed to become McLaren’s racing director (Photo: Red Bull Content Pool) McCullough’s appointment is another significant move in Red Bull’s preparations for the 2027 Formula 1 regulations , which will introduce a major technical overhaul, including new power-unit regulations and revised aerodynamic concepts. [e002:f11] Red Bull is therefore entering a new era both technically and operationally, with McCullough set to play a central role in its trackside operations from 2027 . [e002:f12] For more coverage of Red Bull’s restructuring and the latest developments ahead of the 2027 regulations, follow the F1 section of GRANDE PRÊMIO . [e002:f13] The 2026 Formula 1 season continues this weekend, from September 4 to 6, at Monza. [e002:f14] Tom McCullough will take over as Red Bull’s head of race operations from 2027 , replacing Lambiase in the operational role he currently performs. [e002:f15] McCullough currently serves as Aston Martin’s performance director , having joined the organization back in its Force India days in 2014. [e002:f16] He reversed his decision to leave Red Bull for Williams in order to continue working with the four-time World Champion.
